scenes.text: You know this story. Weeks of late nights, poured into one project!
An app! A report! A pitch deck! And then? Nothing.
They take it to meetings. Long pages! Endless slides! Diagrams! And everyone tunes out.
Great films take great crews! Every job, a specialist. Real craft. But small projects rarely get one.
cues: Real craft. But small projects rarely get one.

scenes.text: What if your project made its own trailer? One prompt starts it! The script! The scenes! The voice! The music! And out comes your film!
cues: What if your project made its own trailer?

scenes.text: Step one. Your project files go in. Code! Documents! Slides! Spreadsheets! An AI assistant reads them, and drafts your script.
cues: Step one. Your project files go in.
An AI assistant reads them, and drafts your script.

scenes.text: Step two. Your story, alive in three D! Streets! People! Motion! Any angle! All of it, just code!
cues: Step two. Your story, alive in three D!

scenes.text: Step three. An AI voice tells it. Choose a voice! Choose a language! Timed to every scene. Change a word? It is spoken again.
cues: Step three. An AI voice tells it.
Choose a voice! Choose a language!
Change a word? It is spoken again.

scenes.text: Step four. A backing track, made in code. Chords! Drums! Bass! Melody! No song copied. No artist imitated. Real songs need real musicians!
cues: Step four. A backing track, made in code.
No song copied. No artist imitated. Real songs need real musicians!

scenes.text: Step five. One single page. Laptop! Phone! Big screen! Or export an MP4, and share it!
cues: Or export an MP4, and share it!

scenes.text: And now? They stop. They watch. The same people. The same project. Finally seen!
cues: The same people. The same project. Finally seen!

scenes.text: This trailer was made with the prompt and the tools you just saw. Yours could be next!
